name: First-tier mount
executable: mountpoint -q /proc    || mount -t proc proc /proc -o nosuid,noexec,nodev && mountpoint -q /sys     || mount -t sysfs sys /sys -o nosuid,noexec,nodev && mountpoint -q /run     || mount -t tmpfs run /run -o mode=0755,nosuid,nodev && mountpoint -q /dev     || mount -t devtmpfs dev /dev -o mode=0755,nosuid && mkdir -p -m0755 /run/lock /dev/pts /dev/shm && mountpoint -q /dev/pts || mount /dev/pts >/dev/null 2>&1 || mount -t devpts devpts /dev/pts -o mode=0620,gid=5,nosuid,noexec && mountpoint -q /dev/shm || mount /dev/shm >/dev/null 2>&1 || mount -t tmpfs shm /dev/shm -o mode=1777,nosuid,nodev
